subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: After atomic authorization is fixed, should plugin-runtime callers permanently fail closed on legacy ownerless session rows?
rationale: Ownerless rows predate this ownership boundary; implicit adoption weakens isolation, while unconditional rejection may break existing plugin-runtime workflows after upgrade.

options.title: Fail closed with recovery
options.body: Reject ownerless rows and provide an operator or doctor recovery path to assign or recreate ownership.

options.title: Controlled adoption
options.body: Add a narrowly authorized, explicit ownership-adoption operation with audit and focused tests.

options.title: Preserve ownerless access
options.body: Keep ownerless rows mutable by plugin runtimes, accepting a weaker isolation boundary for upgrade compatibility.

recommendation.title: Fail closed with recovery
recommendation.body: Reject ownerless rows and provide an operator or doctor recovery path to assign or recreate ownership.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history makes him the strongest routing candidate for the Gateway session lifecycle and security-boundary choice.
